title: Safety Roadside
description: Safety and roadside for Toyota callers: connects roadside requests at once and sorts a warning light, leak, noise or fear of driving into an emergency, a service-due alert or a note for the centre

nodes.title: Enters Safety Roadside
nodes.detail: Safety and roadside for Toyota callers: connects roadside requests at once and sorts a warning light, leak, noise or fear of driving into an emergency, a service-due alert or a note for the centre

nodes.title: Start triage
nodes.detail: Sets caller_words, note_at_entry, safety_outcome, safety_class, caller_location
nodes.comment: Every run of the flow starts clean. safety_note is kept: a specialist may have passed it in. The caller's last words are kept for the reasoning step and for the note, so that what was said just before the hand-over is never lost. safety_outcome starts each visit as no_action, so that the result of an earlier visit on the same call is never what goes back when this one hands a request back before it has an outcome of its own. Every step that completes the flow sets its own value.

nodes.title: Understand concern
nodes.detail: You are on a phone call with someone who may have a safety problem with their Toyota. Work out which one situation applies and record it in safety_class. The steps after this one …
nodes.comment: E01, N22, Q02: the one reasoning step, used when no marker came with the call (a warning light, a leak, a noise, fear of driving, or a specialist's safety escape). It sorts the call into one value of safety_class. Roadside and injury are recorded at once with no question. Q02 "understands the warning first": at most two short questions. MAX_ATTEMPTS 3 = the opening turn plus one caller turn after each of the two questions; after that the call goes to a person, never round again. The only tool here is the approved content search; the transfer and the requests to the teams are reachable from the fixed steps alone. Q02 (assumption, not in the document): what makes a warning an emergency is not defined (analysis GAP-08, X-50). Interim rule: the caller's own judgement decides (not safe, not sure or afraid is an emergency), and smoke, fire, a burning smell, fluid pouring out, overheating, or brakes or steering that do not work are an emergency whatever the caller says. The assistant never says that a car is safe. A marker only acts when the flow starts. When the caller left this step for another request, the thread is kept and a later entry lands in this step again: the step then sorts the call from what the caller says, as it always did, and a marker that came with that entry is put back unused (drop_unused_markers).

nodes.title: Ask location
nodes.detail: The caller's car may not be safe to drive and help is being arranged. One detail is missing, which is where the car is right now. Reported so far: {{safety_note}} Ask one short qu…
nodes.comment: Q02: one question for the place. MAX_ATTEMPTS 2 = the turn that asks plus one answer; a missing place never holds up recovery (a caller who cannot say where the car is goes to roadside at once). A caller who asks for a person here has already been sorted as an emergency: the people they reach are the roadside team, at once and at any hour, not the contact centre queue. The caller can also change the picture here; the fixed routing then runs again on the new value. The tool list keeps the transfer and the requests to the teams out of the model's reach; no tool is needed in this step.

nodes.title: Find nearest centre
nodes.comment: Q02: the nearest centre that is open at this moment and takes an unsafe car without a booking (capability emergency_walkin). The model of the car is passed when known. No hold line is spoken here: the runtime plays the filler while the systems answer. Whatever goes wrong in this step or the next, the caller still goes to roadside (skip_walkin_failed). A place that the centre finder cannot pin to one emirate (emirate_needed) counts as no centre found: a centre that may be the wrong one is never alerted and never named to the caller, and the caller is not asked a second question about the place.

nodes.title: Transfer roadside
nodes.comment: E01, N22, Q02: live transfer to the roadside team. No hours check: it runs at any hour. The destination is deployment configuration; the caller hears the shared roadside line. The platform does not run a call whose spoken line has no text for the caller's language, so that one case is caught first and the transfer is made without the localised line. Only a result that says the transfer succeeded counts as connected. Every other result, and every way the call can fail, ends in transfer_failed and from there with a person: a caller is never left waiting on a transfer that did not happen.

nodes.comment: No safety matter: the note goes back exactly as it came in (empty unless a real concern was reported earlier on this call), whatever was written about the unrelated request. nodes.say: I'm sorry, I couldn't connect you just now.
nodes.comment: Last resort: a recovery road was needed a second time in the same visit, or the hand-over to a person could not be reached. The caller hears that once and the call goes back to the supervisor. No tool, no model call and no hand-over happen here, so this step cannot fail again, and the flag is put back so that no hand-over is tried once more behind it. The caller is not left in silence: the shared question follows, and a caller who asks for roadside again is routed here afresh.

Both recovery roads count their visits in recovery_count: a second visit means the recovery itself failed, and the flow stops instead of going round. The recovery details are not sent by message on this road: the transfer comes first.
